overview: DWARF SHAMAN (Alliance) 1-60, 24 segments, solo, quest-only: no dungeons, no dungeon quests, no raids, no quest the dwarf-shaman digest flags ELITE, only quests from the dwarf-shaman zone digests (737 quests). Every quest id below was run through a simulator that reuses tools/build_route.py (quest_xp with the ForeverXP values and the low-level penalty, XP_TO_LEVEL, KILL_FACTOR 1.7) and checks side/race/class masks, dungeon lists, required levels and prerequisites; the script and the id list live in the planner's scratch folder, not in the repo. DESIGN. (1) 1-24 never leaves the Eastern Kingdoms: Coldridge (01), western Dun Morogh (02), Gol'Bolar + Loch Modan south + Fire Totem (03), Westfall (04), Redridge I + Loch Modan north + Call of Water start (05), Redridge II + Duskwood I (06), Wetlands I (07). TUGs' Darkshore 11-14 / 18-20 detours and its dungeon blocks (Hall of Thanes, Deadmines, Stockade, Blackfathom, Excavation Site, Gnomeregan, Uldaman...) are replaced by the NEW Dun Morogh / Westfall / Redridge / Wetlands quests and by Loch Modan and Duskwood chains TUGs skips. (2) Eight continent crossings in four Kalimdor trips: 24-26 Darkshore road + Ashenvale I + Stonetalon (08, also the Astranaar waterskin); 32-36 Ashenvale II + Desolace (12), Shimmering Flats + Dustwallow (13); 40-46 Tanaris + Flats II (16), Feralas + Tanaris II (17); 50-57 Un'Goro (20), Azshara + Felwood (21), Winterspring (22), Silithus (23). Eastern Kingdoms blocks between them: 26-32 Wetlands II, Duskwood II, Redridge III, Arathi I, Southshore (09-11); 36-40 Swamp, Stranglethorn, Badlands, Alterac, Arathi II, ram (14-15); 46-50 Hinterlands, Searing Gorge, Blasted Lands, Stranglethorn III (18-19); 57-60 Plaguelands + Burning Steppes (24). TUGs' own Alliance path crosses about twice as often. (3) SHAMAN. Archaic Rune 98581 and Call of Earth 94373-94375 in 01 (Earth Totem at 4-5). Call of Fire 94449 from Ingrid Dunwald at 10 -> Bruegs Kindleborn -> Braldir Ashmantle -> 94466-94468, Fire Totem at about 13 (03). Call of Water: 94494 from Eldrun at 20 -> Norric -> Hervdana, brown skin (05); red skin at Stonewatch Falls (06); back to Hervdana (07); blue skin at Astranaar (08); Hervdana -> Norric (09); Stendel's Pond in Westfall (10); Norric = Water Totem at 30 (11). The chain is spread over trips the route makes anyway, which costs about ten levels; the only shortcut is noted in segment 11's risks. Call of Air 94789 from Eldrun at 30 -> Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi = Air Totem at 31 (11); the rest of that chain is dungeon-gated and left out. Trainers (the only three known: Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar, Ingrid Dunwald in Kharanos, Eldrun Stormbreaker in Ironforge 47.6,13.5): 2/4/6 Anvilmar, 6/8/10 Kharanos, 12 and 14 Ironforge (03/04), 18 and 20 (05, Ghost Wolf), 24 optional flight from Menethil (07), 28 (10), 30 and 32 (11, Astral Recall), 36 (14), 38 and 40 (15), 46 (18), 56/58 (24). No crossing is made to train, so the Kalimdor blocks 32-36, 40-46 and 50-57 have no trainer unless Forever has more Alliance shaman trainers than the data shows. (4) MOUNT. Level 40 is reached at the end of segment 15, which finishes in Ironforge/Amberstill Ranch (Ultham Ironhorn, Veron Amberstill; 97017 Your First Riding Ram) before the boat to Theramore. Start saving gold in segment 12. (5) XP HONESTY (simulated, quest XP x1.7 = the project's KILL_FACTOR). 1-40 needs no grinding beyond a 900 XP top-up before level 20: segment ends are 6.0, 10.8, 14.4, 17.3, 20.3, 22.7, 24.0, 26.6, 28.2, 30.8, 32.4, 35.6, 36.8, 39.1, 40.7. From 41 on the digests do not contain enough non-elite, non-dungeon, reachable Alliance quest XP: the plan carries ten explicit L steps worth about 1.26 million XP (L 42 49k in Tanaris, L 45 218k and L 46 19k in Feralas/Tanaris, L 47 100k in the Searing Gorge, L 50 220k in Stranglethorn, L 52 98k in Un'Goro, L 54 144k in Felwood, L 56 211k in Winterspring, L 57 83k in Silithus, L 60 218k in the Plaguelands/Burning Steppes), i.e. roughly a third of 1-60, about the same share the Orc Shaman plan reports. They are placed at reputation or drop farming spots where possible (Timbermaw, Twilight texts, scourgestones, Blasted Lands parts). Optional XP that would shrink the grind, not simulated: NEW quests with no giver data (Shen'dralas / Valley of Bones 35-43 about 40k, Stranglethorn 97328-97420/97047/97048 about 17k, Desolace crafted hand-ins, Swamp 93429/93430); cloth donations in Ironforge (dwarf and gnome quartermasters) and Stormwind, up to 12k each per faction with bought cloth; ELITE-flagged quests that were soloable in Classic (Dragonkin Menace + True Masters about 20k, Thandol Span 631-634, Crushridge, Stromgarde tower); Green Hills of Stranglethorn pages; Sweet Amber (48-53) in Westfall; and the optional dungeon files, which the builder slots in by itself. (6) LOG. Quest log peaks at 19 (segment 14); typical carry between segments is 4-12. carryOut of segment N equals carryIn of segment N+1 and was generated by the simulator. (7) NOT VERIFIED: boat routes (Menethil-Auberdine, Menethil-Theramore, Booty Bay-Ratchet), the Deeprun Tram, flight-path links between known nodes, roads and passes are Classic knowledge; NEW-quest prerequisites exist in the data for only a few chains (see each segment's risks); positions of NEW NPCs come from ForeverChanges pins, not from Questie.
continentCrossings: 1) ~24, seg 07 -> 08: Eastern Kingdoms -> Kalimdor, boat Menethil Harbor -> Auberdine. 2) ~26.5, seg 08 -> 09: Kalimdor -> EK, fly Stonetalon Peak -> Astranaar -> Auberdine, boat Auberdine -> Menethil Harbor. 3) ~32, seg 11 -> 12: EK -> Kalimdor, boat Menethil Harbor -> Auberdine (fly Astranaar). 4) ~36.5, seg 13 -> 14: Kalimdor -> EK, boat Theramore -> Menethil Harbor (fly Ironforge). 5) ~40.5, seg 15 -> 16: EK -> Kalimdor, boat Menethil Harbor -> Theramore (on the new ram; fly Ratchet, Gadgetzan). 6) ~46, seg 17 -> 18: Kalimdor -> EK, fly Gadgetzan -> Theramore, boat Theramore -> Menethil Harbor. 7) ~50, seg 19 -> 20: EK -> Kalimdor, boat Booty Bay -> Ratchet (fly Gadgetzan). 8) ~57, seg 23 -> 24: Kalimdor -> EK, fly Cenarion Hold -> Gadgetzan -> Theramore, boat Theramore -> Menethil Harbor (fly Ironforge). Total 8 (four Kalimdor trips). No teleports; the Deeprun Tram (Ironforge <-> Stormwind) and gryphons are not crossings. All boat routes are Classic knowledge and were not re-checked in 1.60.1; the ForeverChanges text of 94500 says the Menethil -> Auberdine boat stops in Southshore in Forever.
